sections.symptoms_of_paget_s_disease:
Sometimes the people who have this disease do not know that they have this disease because it has no symptoms in some cases. 
 The common symptom is bone pain. The signs and symptoms of disease depend upon the part of the body affected. It may affect one or more parts of the body. 

 Pelvis : Hip pain is there in this case. 
 Skull – Bone abnormality in skull may cause hearing loss or headaches. 
 Spine- When spine is affected, nerve roots can be compressed that may cause pain, tingling and numbness in arms or legs. 
 Leg – Weakness in the bones may cause bending and the patient becomes bowlegged. It may put extra pressure on surrounding joints and may cause osteoarthritis in your knee or hip.
sections.causes_of_paget_s_disease:
The exact cause of disease is unknown. Genetic and Environmental factors may cause this disease. 

 Genetic factors- There is an important gene called SQSTM1 which is involved in this disease. Mutation in this gene increases the risk of Paget’s disease. People who have inherited this mutated gene are at risk of developing Paget’s disease. 
 Virus – Some scientists believe that it may be caused by a virus named Paramyxovirus nucleocapsid which is not found in normal bone. 
 Environmental factors – These are also important causative agents.
sections.complications_associated_with_paget_s_di:
This disease may progress slowly with time. Some common complications may arise which are following: 

 Fracture and Deformities 
 Osteoarthritis 
 Heart failure 
 Bone cancer
sections.diagnosis:
It can be diagnosed with the help of physical examination, imaging and blood tests. 
 Physical examination:- 
 It helps to diagnose the area where pain is there. 
 Imaging tests:- 

 X-Ray – X-ray image of the affected area is helpful to diagnose the bone reabsorption, enlargement and deformities which are symptoms of Paget’s disease. 
 Bone scan – It helps to produce a scanned image of bone with the help of radioactive substance which is injected into the body and spots on affected bone. 
 Laboratory tests – It includes the blood tests which are helpful in measuring the alkaline phosphatase level in blood. 

 Ayurvedic Outlook 
 There are three energies (vata, pitta and kapha) in the body which are responsible for good health. Imbalance of any three results in health complications. Vata is dry (rooksha) in nature when it gets vitiated then problems in any of the joints may arise. 
 Paget’s disease is due to vitiation of vata and it can be compared to Asthi Dhatu Kshaya(Decrease in bone density) in Ayurveda.

 About Paget’s Disease 
 It is also known as Osteitis Deformans. It is a localised bone disorder which is characterised by abnormal growth of bone. It may affect one or more bones. The risk of this disease increases with age. It commonly occurs after the age of 50. 
 In normal cases, bone tissue is continuously broken down and rebuilt in a balanced process called bone remodeling. Old bone is absorbed (resorbed) by the body and replaced with new bone tissue. 
 In Paget’s disease of bone, this process becomes abnormal. Bone breakdown (resorption) happens faster than normal, and in response, the body speeds up the rebuilding process. However, the new bone is often larger, weaker, and more brittle, making it more prone to deformities and fractures. 
 Paget’s disease commonly affects the pelvis, skull, spine, and long bones of the legs, and can lead to pain, bone deformities, and other complications over time.
